notes.title: Teabat! - Version v1.0.2 - Release Notes
notes.content:
[b]Version 1.0.2[/b]
Minor fixes and screenshot feature

[b]General[/b]
 - Minor tile placement fixes and improvements

[b]Steam[/b]
 - Added support for taking and uploading screenshots!
 
[b]Arcade Mode[/b]
 - Added "Retry" button to pause menu
 
[b]Online[/b]
  - Fixed swinging hooks and vines being occasionally flaky during high ping
  - Fix crash when attempting to set server port to an empty string

notes.title: Teabat! - Version v1.0.1 - Release Notes
notes.content:
[b]Version 1.0.1[/b]
Minor fixes and polish

[b]Changes:[/b]
 - Teapot radar on map display sensitivity is now determined by difficulty level
  - Hard has no radar
  - Normal has a reduced range

[b]Polish:[/b]
 - Removed outdated line from Spectral Lens item description
 
[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
 - Fixed minor tiling inconsistencies
 - Fixed Arcade Mode lacking UI reflections
 
[b]Localizations:[/b]
 - Updated Spanish shop dialog

notes.title: Teabat! - Demo v1.1.0 - Release Notes
notes.content:
[b]Demo Version 1.1.0[/b]
  Major fixes and minor graphical improvements

[b]Release Notes[/b]:
[list]
[*] [b]Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed potential crash when trying to apply from an empty space in the inventory
[*] Fixed rare graphical bug when replaying the demo after dying and running out of time simultaneously
[/list]
[*] [b]Polish[/b]
[list]
[*] Minor graphical improvements
[*] Minor localization tweaks and improvements
[*] Echo location better follows the Great Trea
[*] Decreased application size by a few MB
[*] Demo now loads considerably faster
[/list]
[*] [b]Changes[/b]
[list]
[*] Teabat's doublejump height was increased slightly
[/list]
[/list]

notes.title: Teabat! - Demo v1.01 - Release Notes
notes.content:

[*] Added Default Input Configuration.
[/list]
[*] [b]Fixes[/b]
[list]

[/list]
[*] [b]Polish[/b]

[/list]
[/list]
